name: User Intuition
description: Run qualitative research with real people: AI-moderated in-depth interviews, concept tests, and prototype tests.

skills.name: analyze-completed-study
skills.description: Use when the user wants findings, themes, evidence, or a report from completed User Intuition interviews.

skills.name: create-study-from-brief
skills.description: Use when the user wants to create a User Intuition interview study from a brief, goal, problem, or research idea.

skills.name: curate-interview-quality
skills.description: Use when the user wants to review interview quality or explicitly delete unusable interviews from one User Intuition study.

skills.name: design-screeners
skills.description: Use when the user wants to screen participants, define qualification criteria, or target a Panel study.

skills.name: field-a-panel
skills.description: Use when the user wants to estimate, launch, pause, resume, or stop recruitment for a User Intuition Panel study.

skills.name: interview-brand-switchers
skills.description: Use when the user wants to know why shoppers switched brands, traded down to private label, or chose a competitor, interviewing switchers recruited from the consumer panel rather than their own customer list.

skills.name: interview-cancellations
skills.description: Use when the user wants to interview subscribers who cancelled, churned, downgraded, or paused, using subscription data from Stripe, a billing system, or an export.

skills.name: interview-category-shoppers
skills.description: Use when the user wants to interview shoppers of a category or brand, such as frozen pizza buyers or skincare shoppers, or learn how consumers choose in a category, recruited from the consumer panel by what they buy.

skills.name: interview-lapsed-customers
skills.description: Use when the user wants to interview lapsed or one-time buyers about why they stopped buying or did not reorder, using order history from Shopify, a store, a CRM, or loyalty-card or retailer data.

skills.name: interview-recent-buyers
skills.description: Use when the user wants to interview recent buyers or new customers about why they bought, what nearly stopped the order, or how the first product landed, using Shopify or store orders, loyalty-card or retailer data, or a customer export.

skills.name: investigate-drop-off
skills.description: Use when the user wants to interview people who abandoned a cart, checkout, signup, onboarding, or feature, from a funnel drop-off in PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or another analytics tool.

skills.name: invite-your-own-participants
skills.description: Use when the user wants to add, invite, update, or reward their own participants in a BYOP study.

skills.name: map-shopper-journey
skills.description: Use when the user wants to map the shopper journey or path to purchase, in store or online: the trip trigger, the shelf or product page, substitutions, and the decision in the aisle.

skills.name: monitor-fielding
skills.description: Use when the user wants a read-only status snapshot of User Intuition studies or interviews.

skills.name: retrieve-study-results
skills.description: Use when the user wants an existing User Intuition study report, its evidence coverage, or the interview evidence behind a finding, without regenerating analysis.

skills.name: run-a-concept-test
skills.description: Use when the user wants participants to react to a concept, pack design, claim, message, ad, prototype, or landing page in a User Intuition interview, including pack, claims, and concept tests.

skills.name: run-usage-and-attitudes
skills.description: Use when the user wants a usage and attitudes (U&A) study: how and when consumers use a product or category, occasions, habits, needs, brand repertoire, or white space for a consumer brand.

skills.name: run-win-loss
skills.description: Use when the user wants win-loss interviews with buyers on won or lost deals, or to learn why prospects chose a competitor, using closed deals from HubSpot, Salesforce, or another CRM.

skills.name: search-research
skills.description: Use when the user wants existing User Intuition findings or participant responses across studies, before deciding whether new qualitative research is needed.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Use when User Intuition was just installed or connected, or the user asks how to get started, whether their account is connected, or what it can do for qualitative research. Checks the connection and routes to the right workflow. Not for a specific request another skill covers.

skills.name: user-research
skills.description: Use when the user wants to plan qualitative research or customer interviews, write a discussion guide or screener, synthesize transcripts, notes, reviews, or survey answers into themes, test a concept, pack, or message, or run AI-moderated interviews with real people, from shopper, path-to-purchase, and usage and attitudes research for CPG brands and retailers to product research for tech teams.
